title: Freeze declaration evidence during preparation
objective: Prepare deterministic declaration evidence once at the shared Change and Slice seam so every Agent Brief receives complete, approved interface context before execution.
requirements: One shared declaration-evidence module accepts a Slice Draft plus controlled frozen-source and dependency lookups, parses only relevant TypeScript declarations in memory with the pinned OXC parser, and returns either complete evidence or typed findings without partial output.

For a declaration that already exists in a frozen modify target, evidence contains its deterministic bounded transitive closure of exported and local supporting project declarations, with stable ordering, provenance, normalized shapes, and digests; cycles appear once and terminate.

For a declaration that is new or belongs to an absent create target, evidence is normalized from the authoritative authored Documented Declaration without inspecting a missing file; mixed work combines inspected existing evidence and authored new evidence in one result.

Every relevant reference has one deterministic route to a same-file declaration, project file, TypeScript global, Node platform module, or version-bound external package leaf. Missing, ambiguous, unsupported, incomplete, or over-limit relevant declarations return precise typed preparation findings before review, while unrelated syntax is not parsed or rejected.

Each prepared Agent Brief receives only the declaration evidence needed for declarations it owns or consumes. Each evidence item is immutable, bound to its frozen sources and authored declaration digests, and included in the prepared revision and preparation digest without changing Documented Declaration authority.

The shared prepareValidatedSliceDraft path supplies the same evidence behavior to Changes and Slices, supports an empty greenfield project, and performs no TypeScript project construction, repository copy, environment loading, dependency installation, project command execution, candidate verification, Runner work, or source-file writes.

Focused tests cover existing, greenfield, and mixed preparation; cyclic support; exact missing, ambiguous, unsupported, incomplete, and bounded findings; relevant-only failure; byte-identical repeated evidence and digests; Change and Slice routing; and unchanged source bytes.

files.task: Create the small production declaration-evidence module. Parse frozen strings with OXC, normalize only declaration structure, build deterministic bounded closures, and discard ASTs before returning. Treat authored declarations as authority and inspected source as evidence. Resolve source and dependency facts only through the supplied lookups, return no partial bundle on a finding, and do not import or copy the experimental prototype.

owns.name: DeclarationEvidenceSource
owns.declaration: export interface DeclarationEvidenceSource { readonly path: string; readonly mediaType: string; readonly content: string; readonly contentDigest: string; }
owns.description: One exact UTF-8 project file already captured for in-memory declaration inspection.

owns.name: DeclarationEvidenceSourceLookup
owns.declaration: export type DeclarationEvidenceSourceLookup = (path: string) => { readonly status: "found"; readonly source: DeclarationEvidenceSource } | { readonly status: "missing" } | { readonly status: "invalid"; readonly finding: SliceFinding };
owns.description: The controlled preparation callback that returns frozen source bytes, absence, or one safe typed file finding without exposing ambient repository access to the parser.

owns.name: DeclarationEvidenceDependency
owns.declaration: export interface DeclarationEvidenceDependency { readonly packageName: string; readonly version: string; readonly lockSource: DeclarationEvidenceSource; }
owns.description: One external package version proven by a frozen dependency-lock file that becomes part of the prepared source revision.

owns.name: DeclarationEvidenceDependencyLookup
owns.declaration: export type DeclarationEvidenceDependencyLookup = (packageName: string) => { readonly status: "found"; readonly dependency: DeclarationEvidenceDependency } | { readonly status: "missing" } | { readonly status: "invalid"; readonly finding: SliceFinding };
owns.description: The controlled callback used only when a relevant declaration refers to an external package.

owns.name: DECLARATION_EVIDENCE_LIMITS
owns.declaration: export const DECLARATION_EVIDENCE_LIMITS: { readonly maxSourceFiles: 256; readonly maxSingleSourceBytes: 524288; readonly maxTotalSourceBytes: 2097152; readonly maxDeclarations: 64; readonly maxDeclarationBytes: 262144 } = { maxSourceFiles: 256, maxSingleSourceBytes: 524288, maxTotalSourceBytes: 2097152, maxDeclarations: 64, maxDeclarationBytes: 262144 };
owns.description: The exact preparation limits for frozen source files and declaration closures.

owns.name: DECLARATION_EVIDENCE_FINDING_CODES
owns.description: The complete stable code set for declaration-evidence preparation findings.

owns.name: DeclarationEvidenceBundle
owns.declaration: export interface DeclarationEvidenceBundle { readonly schema: "score.declaration-evidence"; readonly version: "1.0.0"; readonly targetPath: string; readonly parser: { readonly name: "oxc-parser"; readonly version: "0.144.0" }; readonly normalizer: { readonly name: "score.declaration-shape"; readonly version: "1.0.0" }; readonly roots: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly role: "owned" | "consumed"; readonly ownerPath: string; readonly name: string; readonly namespace: "type" | "value" }>; readonly sources: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly kind: "typescript" | "dependency_lock"; readonly path: string; readonly contentDigest: string }>; readonly declarations: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly ownerPath: string; readonly name: string; readonly namespace: "type" | "value"; readonly visibility: "exported" | "local_supporting"; readonly declaration: string; readonly declarationDigest: string; readonly normalizedShapeJson: string; readonly shapeDigest: string; readonly provenance: { readonly kind: "authored"; readonly authoredDeclarationDigest: string } | { readonly kind: "inspected"; readonly sourcePath: string; readonly sourceDigest: string }; readonly references: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly name: string; readonly namespace: "type" | "value"; readonly resolution: { readonly kind: "same_file"; readonly declarationName: string } | { readonly kind: "project_file"; readonly source: string; readonly targetPath: string; readonly importedName: string } | { readonly kind: "typescript_global" } | { readonly kind: "node_platform"; readonly source: string; readonly importedName: string } | { readonly kind: "external_package"; readonly packageName: string; readonly source: string; readonly importedName: string; readonly version: string; readonly lockPath: string; readonly lockDigest: string } }> }>; readonly contentDigest: string; }
owns.description: The immutable per-Agent Brief projection of normalized authored and inspected declaration evidence, including exact provenance, routing, bounds, parser identity, and its canonical digest.

owns.name: DeclarationEvidenceResult
owns.declaration: export type DeclarationEvidenceResult = { readonly status: "ok"; readonly bundles: ReadonlyArray<DeclarationEvidenceBundle>; readonly usedSources: ReadonlyArray<DeclarationEvidenceSource> } | { readonly status: "invalid"; readonly findings: ReadonlyArray<SliceFinding> };
owns.description: The all-or-nothing preparation result: complete per-Agent evidence and every source it used, or precise typed findings with no evidence bundle.

owns.name: prepareDeclarationEvidence
owns.declaration: export function prepareDeclarationEvidence(input: { readonly draft: SliceDraft; readonly lookupSource: DeclarationEvidenceSourceLookup; readonly lookupDependency: DeclarationEvidenceDependencyLookup }): DeclarationEvidenceResult;
owns.description: Builds deterministic bounded declaration evidence entirely from the authored draft and controlled frozen source and dependency lookups.

context.purpose: Supply the existing SliceDraft, DeclarationDraft, and SliceFinding contracts consumed by the new module.
Supply the existing canonical JSON and SHA-256 helpers used for stable shape and bundle digests.
Supply the existing normalized project-relative path rule used by preparation.
Supply the existing deterministic repository path ordering helper.
Show the pinned OXC parser and diagnostic conventions already used by inspect-module without making this work replace or call its filesystem-facing CLI path.
Record the successful feasibility result and its limits; it is evidence for the design, not production code to copy.

constraints: Use `import type { SliceDraft, SliceFinding } from "./slice-draft.js";`, import canonical digest helpers from `./canonical.js`, and use the supplied lookup for project bytes.
Do not read process state, environment variables, compiler configuration, installed package declarations, or implementation bodies that are not part of a relevant declaration contract.

Do not import from `src/prototypes/` or copy the large experimental implementation wholesale; implement the smallest supported production subset and fail closed with a typed finding for relevant unsupported syntax.

Support direct exported and local supporting interfaces, type aliases, functions or declared functions with explicit parameter and return annotations, and one named variable with an explicit type annotation. Treat default exports, export-all, namespaces, import-equals, inline import types, destructured variables, overloaded or duplicate declarations, and missing function or variable annotations as relevant unsupported or incomplete syntax.

Parse every authored Documented Declaration as one TypeScript declaration snippet even when its target is not a TypeScript file. For a create target, a non-TypeScript target, or a name absent from a modify target, use the authored declaration as the evidence source. Inspect a modify target only when its path ends in .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .d.ts, .d.mts, or .d.cts and it contains the named declaration. A target with no owned or consumed declarations receives an empty bundle.

When OXC reports syntax problems, reject only a diagnostic whose labeled range intersects a relevant declaration or its import or export route. Ignore unrelated diagnostics unless they prevent the relevant route from being proven, in which case return DECLARATION_REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED.

Resolve a relative import with the exact candidate order already used by inspect-module closure: explicit TypeScript paths stay exact; .js maps to .ts, .tsx, then .d.ts; .mjs maps to .mts then .d.mts; .cjs maps to .cts then .d.cts; extensionless paths try .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .d.ts, then the same index forms. Zero matches returns DECLARATION_SOURCE_MISSING and more than one returns DECLARATION_SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS. Do not read tsconfig paths or guess any other route.

Use the exact exported DECLARATION_EVIDENCE_FINDING_CODES values. A finding location is the JSON Pointer of the owned declaration or consumed declaration that started the failed closure. Put the supporting ownerPath, declarationName, referenceName, candidatePaths, and observed byte or count values in detail when applicable. Sort findings by location, code, and canonical detail.

Apply DECLARATION_EVIDENCE_LIMITS before adding each source or declaration. Count UTF-8 bytes, count each source path and declaration key once, and return DECLARATION_EVIDENCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED without a partial bundle when any exact limit would be crossed.

Sort bundles by targetPath; roots by owned before consumed, then ownerPath, name, and namespace; sources by kind then path; declarations by ownerPath, name, namespace, and visibility; and references by name, namespace, then canonical resolution JSON. Include cyclic declarations once by the same declaration key.

Build normalizedShapeJson with the experiment's small production projection, not a raw AST. A function shape is exactly { kind: "function", name, async, generator, typeParameters, params, returnType }; an interface shape is { kind: "interface", name, typeParameters, extends, body }; a type-alias shape is { kind: "type", name, typeParameters, typeAnnotation }; and a variable shape is { kind: "const" | "let" | "var", name, typeAnnotation }. Recursively normalize only those selected child values, preserving array order and every other OXC property while omitting exactly start, end, range, loc, raw, parent, scopeId, symbolId, and referenceId. canonicalJson that shape into normalizedShapeJson; do not include function bodies or variable initializers. shapeDigest is sha256Json of the parsed normalizedShapeJson value. declarationDigest is the SHA-256 digest of the exact declaration string.

Compute contentDigest as sha256Json of the complete bundle object without its contentDigest field. usedSources contains each exact source returned by either lookup once in path order, including a dependency lock source used for an external package.

External packages and `node:` platform modules are leaves. Never recurse into node_modules. Call lookupDependency only for a relevant bare package reference and require its exact version and frozen lockSource; missing or invalid proof returns the matching declared finding code.
Do not add candidate comparison, declaration verification, Runner integration, Repair Notices, retry behavior, or automatic Agent execution.

Add one Contract Input with handle input_declaration_evidence, logical name declaration-evidence, required true, expected kind declaration_evidence, version rule =1.0.0, and cardinality exactly one. Add exactly one Context Item per Agent Brief with handle declaration_evidence_${ordinal}, kind declaration_evidence, version 1.0.0, source kind derived_declaration_evidence, locator equal to the target path, source version equal to the bundle contentDigest, inline resolution, and content equal to only that target's bundle.

Order each Agent Brief Context Set and its bindings as target state, allocated requirements, documented declarations, declaration evidence, execution flows when present, project context, then skills. Bind declaration evidence at position zero of input_declaration_evidence.
Keep the existing documented_declarations Context Item unchanged and authoritative. Evidence is an additional input binding, not a replacement.
